description: Pharmacologic drug-target coverage for ASCVD risk factors. Built from a curated domain-knowledge drug-target map (82 factors mapped by hand) plus category-level defaults for the remainder, with corroborating example trial NCTs matched from raw_trials.json interventions. Category defaults are direction/modifiability-gated: non-modifiable, protective, or mixed-direction traits (and low-adiposity anthropometric traits) are not assigned a drug target.

target_status_legend.approved: ≥1 approved agent modifies this factor (directly or as its established drug class)
target_status_legend.investigational: agents in clinical development target this factor; none yet approved for this indication
target_status_legend.lifestyle_only: modifiable but addressed by behavioral/lifestyle intervention, no specific approved pharmacotherapy targeting it for ASCVD
target_status_legend.none: no drug target (non-modifiable, or a biomarker/imaging marker that is not itself a therapeutic target)
